title: Nosebleed
summary: Sit up, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose firmly for 10–15 minutes without letting go.

callEmergency.headline: Get medical help if the bleeding does not stop
when: Bleeding continues for more than 20 minutes
Heavy bleeding, or after a head injury
They feel faint, or are taking blood thinners

steps.title: Sit and lean forward
steps.text: Sit them down, leaning forward so blood drains out of the nose, not down the throat.

steps.title: Pinch the soft part of the nose
steps.text: Pinch firmly just below the bony bridge and keep pinching. Breathe through the mouth.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: After 10–15 minutes, release gently. If still bleeding, pinch again for another 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Afterwards
steps.text: Avoid blowing the nose, strenuous activity and hot drinks for some hours.

warningSigns: Clear fluid from the nose after a head injury
doNot: Do not tilt the head back
Do not keep releasing to check

sources.body: American Heart Association and American Red Cross
